name: IMA_IMPACT_WINDOW_IP_TRACK

attribution.rule: retain only where supported by invention records and applicable law; professional review required

truth_rules: Do not call an invention disclosure a patent application.
Do not call a patent application a patent grant.
Do not claim novelty or freedom-to-operate without professional legal analysis.
Do not expose enabling details publicly merely for reputation before an IP strategy review.

participant-scope-aware access control and persistent AI agents with cross-platform continuity
MCP-driven accessibility tree standardization for AI screen-reader agents

current_prior_art.topic: MCP+A2A, provenance, consent, edge/cloud and policy controls

novelty_hypotheses: A user-scoped interactive intelligence window whose canonical timeline binds request→authorization→observation→action→result→verification→learning across host capabilities.
Capability negotiation plus runtime verification preventing the system from claiming native above-all-app control until the host proves the capability.
A privacy-minimized, per-user continuity layer that can move across devices/hosts while preserving authorization scope and verified state.
Impact Window as an agency-preserving surface: action is bounded by explicit authorization, result verification and learning rather than autonomous persistence.

implementation.host_rule: capability negotiation → runtime verification → use only verified capabilities

low_cost_ip_routes: innovation authority/grant programs that permit IP/legal support
licensed patent professional review before filing
blockers: Publicly available prior art is not exhaustive.
Inventorship/ownership must be verified from actual contribution and agreements.
A patent filing/grant and commercialization are distinct events.
next_high_value_action: Build a dated claim chart for the four novelty hypotheses against the identified prior art, then route the narrowed invention disclosure to professional patent review before public technical disclosure.
